objectives.description: Identify Mini-ITX architecture and inspect both faces
Isolate EPS and 24-pin power paths; identify 10+1+1 stages
Inspect AM5 socket and DDR5 A/B channels
Compare front Gen5 and rear Gen4 M.2 paths
Inspect PCIe and B850 chipset connectivity
Inspect thermal interfaces and fan headers
Explain BIOS Flashback and virtual recovery
Perform final cold-start qualification using authoritative solver evidence
